summary: History test, frozen earlier this month: all four pre-registered stock rules were rejected against random baskets from this list, and simply holding every name equally did better than any rule and than the core. Setup checks and past strength have shown no edge here. Today: three neutral, low calls on the paper holdings, unchanged from recent runs; Amgen and Cintas move to watch. Nothing here is expected to beat the index. Pretend money only; real money stays in the whole-market plan.
eli5: The brain tested its stock-picking rules, and they did no better than pulling names out of a hat. So today it only watches three stocks with pretend money, like watching a race without betting. The family's real money stays in the big basket that holds the whole market.

pick.thesis: Neutral and low, unchanged from the brain's recent runs: nothing in the data justifies a change. All four setup checks pass and it is not stretched, and it has done far better than the benchmark over the last quarter, but only after a weak year. The frozen history test rejected every rule built on such checks, and gate passers did no better than the benchmark in the base rates. Pershing Square's disclosed book holds it; this call neither follows nor fights that fund, whose matured calls both missed.
risks: Earnings report expected in about two weeks, date not confirmed, inside the scoring window; a stock that ran hard into a report can drop even on good news.
